subject: Pilot commercial ask: deferred revenue & upfront structure
messages:
From: Tom Davis <tdavis@luminatehealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@luminatehealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot commercial ask: deferred revenue & reduced upfront

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile for the clinical summarization pilot. Before we move to SOW, procurement flagged a concern on our side: Luminate has a constrained Q3 budget and we'd like to request more flexibility on the upfront commitment.

Concretely, would you consider: 1) reducing the 60% upfront payment to 30% for the pilot, and 2) deferring the remaining recognized revenue over a 12-month schedule so our finance team can smooth recognition? This would let us accelerate the pilot without stretching our current cash plan.

If you need a formal finance note, I can ask our controller to summarize. We'd like to keep the commercial terms otherwise intact (pilot length 6 months, 10k monthly token entitlement).

Appreciate a quick indicator if that's something Redwood can entertain — if not, please advise alternatives.

Thanks,
Tom Davis
Sr. Procurement Manager
Luminate Health
[Attachment: Luminate_RFP_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot commercial ask: deferred revenue & reduced upfront

Marissa / Markus — forwarding Tom's procurement note.

Summary: Luminate asked to cut the 60% upfront to 30% for a 6-month pilot and to have the remainder recognized over 12 months. They emphasize it's a cash/timing issue rather than a desire for a bigger discount. Pilot is strategic: potential to expand into a 3-region, dedicated deployment if successful.

I ran a quick unit-econ on our side and attached a brief analysis (see revenue-offset-analysis.xlsx). Key points:
- Total ARR-equivalent isn't changing; this is timing.
- Short-term cash hit if we reduce upfront; estimated cash shortfall ~ $90k in Q3 for the proposed pilot size.
- Customer is open to tradeoffs: slightly shorter pilot term, or adding a modest prepay credit in exchange for extended commitment on conversion.

Ask: we need conditional VP/CFO signoff to proceed with a deferred recognition arrangement and the reduced up-front. If approved, I'll send an SOW with revised payment schedule and a DocuSign link. If not, I want guidance on alternative concessions (e.g., keep 60% up-front but add a 10% pilot discount).

Attachments: revenue-offset-analysis.xlsx (spreadsheet) — quick numbers; I'll drop a formatted memo if you'd like.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0158
[Attachment: revenue-offset-analysis.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot commercial ask: deferred revenue & reduced upfront

Grace — thanks for the concise summary and the spreadsheet. I looped in finance offline and had a couple of quick reactions.

On principle, we don't want to create a precedent of long-term deferrals for pilots without compensating protections, but I'm sympathetic given this is a strategic prospective customer with a clear path to enterprise. Options I'd accept:

1) Approve a 30% upfront / 70% deferred over 12 months for the pilot only, provided we:
   - Include a non-refundable onboarding fee of $5k due on signing (to cover initial operational cost).
   - Add a mandatory conversion clause: if they convert to Dedicated within 9 months, remaining deferred balance accelerates as revenue on conversion (no further discount).

2) Alternatively, keep 60% upfront but offer a 10% credit on first three months (lower revenue recognition impact, but preserves cash).

If we go with option 1, we'll need a short redline for legal and a note for Finance confirming the deferral schedule and that it will be tracked in our deferred revenue ledger. 

Condition: final sign-off from CFO (Marissa) is required because this changes cash-flow and recognition policy for the deal. If Marissa is comfortable, I approve in principle.

Please prepare: a 1-page memo that states rationale, cash impact, and the proposed safeguarding clauses (onboarding fee, conversion acceleration). Also attach the SOW v2 with explicit payment schedule and DocuSign link.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Davis <tdavis@luminatehealth.com>, procurement@luminatehealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial ask: deferred revenue & reduced upfront

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: we're able to approve a modified payment plan for the pilot with a couple of safeguards.

Proposed (approved in principle by VP, Commercial Finance pending CFO sign-off):
- Total pilot value: $360,000 (6 months at $60k/mo token commitment).
- Payment schedule: 30% due at signing ($108,000), onboarding fee $5,000 due at signing, remaining balance of $247,000 to be invoiced and recognized on a 12-month deferred schedule (monthly recognition) unless customer converts earlier.
- Conversion clause: if Luminate converts to a Dedicated Contract within 9 months of pilot start, the deferred balance will accelerate and be recognized in full on conversion; contract value remains unchanged.
- No additional discount beyond the changed timing.

Next steps from Redwood side: I'll send SOW v2 and DocuSign envelope for signature. CFO final sign-off will be indicated on the DocuSign notes (Marissa will countersign).

Do you want me to include an explicit accounting contact line for your controller to coordinate the recognition note? If yes, please share their name/email and we'll copy them on the SOW and revenue schedule.

If those terms look OK, we'll issue SOW v2 and the DocuSign link later today.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
